lines.text: Jeroboam's son Abijah falls ill, so he sends his disguised wife to Shiloh with ten loaves, cakes and honey.
Ahijah, whose eyes are dim with age, hears her feet at the door and greets her as Jeroboam's wife.
The LORD says He tore the kingdom from the house of Saul and gave it to Jeroboam, who made other gods.
The LORD will cut off every male from Jeroboam's house, and the child will die when her feet enter Tirzah.
The LORD will scatter Israel beyond the Euphrates, and after Jeroboam reigns twenty-two years, his son Nadab reigns.
